articles.summary: Xenia Hotels Resorts, Inc. (NYSE: XHR) ("Xenia" or the "Company") today announced results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 . Third Quarter 2026 Highlights Net Loss: Net loss attributable to common stockholders was $2.7 million, compared to a net loss of $13.7 million for the same period in 2025 Net Loss per Diluted Share: Net loss attributable to common stockholders per diluted share was $0.03, compared to $0.14 for the same period in 2025 Adjusted EBITDAre : $53.2 million, increased 26.0% compared to the third quarter of 2025 Adjusted FFO per Diluted Share: $0.36, increased 56.5% compared to the third quarter of 2025 Same-Property Occupancy: 70.0%, increased 380 basis points compared to the third quarter of 2025 Same-Property ADR: $264.00, increased 6.4% compared to the third quarter of 2025 Same-Property RevPAR: $184.75, increased 12.5% compared to the third quarter of 2025 Same-Property Total RevPAR: $325.71, increased 12.7% compared to the third quarter of 2025
articles.title: Xenia Hotels & Resorts Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
